CVPR 2023
Defining and Quantifying the Emergence of Sparse Concepts in DNNs

用Harsanyi dividend表述全部交互的精确重构与唯一性；论文还报告提取少量显著概念的经验方法。

ICLR 2024
Where We Have Arrived in Proving the Emergence of Sparse Interaction Primitives in DNNs

分析DNN中稀疏交互出现的充分条件，并复述、证明Harsanyi交互的精确匹配恒等式。

Defining and Extracting Generalizable Interaction Primitives from DNNs

研究不同DNN共同抽取的AND/OR交互，区分精确匹配与交互的泛化能力。
